records.summary: A National Speleological Society caving grotto based in Belleville, Pennsylvania.
records.notes: Out of area. The NSS listing gives a Belleville, PA address and does not say the grotto meets in or serves Philadelphia. Its own site (sevenvalleysgrotto.org) did not resolve, so no current activity was checked. Revisit if it turns out to meet in Philadelphia.

records.name: African Cultural Alliance of North America (ACANA)
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that offers community services, including immigration and legal help, health checks, workforce and construction training, digital skills classes, and youth workshops.
records.what_you_do: Take a training or class, come to a health screening, or join the monthly Wellness check-in on Zoom. The site lists some programs as free and gives no cost for others.

schedule.text: Monthly Wellness check-in on Zoom, Wednesdays 5 to 6:30 pm Eastern. Workshops and trainings run on dates listed on the site, such as a construction training open house on 2026-10-16.

cost.text: Some programs are free, such as the construction training and a hepatitis B screening. The site gives no cost for others.

first_step.how: Come to the construction training open house at 5521 Chester Avenue on 2026-10-16, or ask about the 10-week course that starts 2026-11-02.
first_step.basis: The open house and the monthly check-in have dates, times and a way to attend. Enrollment steps for other programs are not explained on the site.

records.notes: The opportunities page gives the email as info@acanus.org, which differs from info@acanaus.org on the home page. The home page address is used here. The site lists no open jobs and no volunteer or membership steps. Donations go through a PayPal link. The newest dated post is 2026-08-03, and later dated events are listed. Social handles come from a page summary and should be checked once.

records.name: Anna Crusis Feminist Choir
records.summary: A nonprofit feminist choir in Philadelphia that welcomes new singers through auditions. The most recent audition round we found was held in July 2026.
records.what_you_do: Audition to join as a singer and sing with the choir. Supporters can also give a donation of their choosing.

schedule.text: Rehearsal times are not listed on the site. Auditions were held in Center City on 2026-07-25 and 2026-07-26.

cost.text: The site invites donations and lists no membership fee. Joining costs are not stated.

first_step.how: Check the audition page at annacrusis.org/auditions/ for the next round, then sign up for an audition.
first_step.basis: Joining requires an audition, and the next audition date is not listed. The site says all SSAA voices are welcome.

records.notes: The site gives no rehearsal times, no contact email and no fee. SSAA is a standard choir code for soprano and alto parts. The site does not explain more about who may join, so no community tags were set.

records.name: AMC Delaware Valley 20s and 30s Group
records.summary: The young adult group of the Appalachian Mountain Club's Delaware Valley chapter, for people in their 20s and 30s. It runs outdoor outings and gives members a way to meet other young adults.
records.what_you_do: Register for an outing on the group's event listings, go outdoors with other young adults, or join the mailing list by email.

schedule.text: Events run most weekends. Meeting times and outing start points are not listed on the page.

locations.label: Outings around Philadelphia, the Lehigh Valley and nearby New Jersey counties

cost.text: Most outings are free, and AMC membership is optional.

first_step.how: Find an outing on the group's event listings, register for it, and go. Membership is not needed.
first_step.basis: Activities are open to all and registration is the only listed step. The page does not say what beginners should bring or expect.

records.notes: Status conflict for the importer to decide. The group's own pages describe current outings but show no dated item, so status is probably_active with no last_sign_of_life date. The chapter's events page returned a 404. The batch website was a generic Meetup page (a lead only), so the chapter's group page is used instead. The Meetup and chapter social links are the chapter's own published links.

records.name: Asociación Puertorriqueños en Marcha (APM)
records.summary: A Latino-based nonprofit in North Philadelphia that offers health and behavioral health care, foster care and adoption, family and children's services, early childhood education, and community and economic development.
records.what_you_do: Ask the main office about the program you need, or a referral. The site does not describe volunteer steps.

schedule.text: Program hours are not listed on the website. Call the office for times.

cost.text: Costs vary by program and are not listed on the website.

first_step.how: Call the main line at 267-296-7200 and ask about the program you need, such as early childhood or family services.
first_step.basis: A public phone line and office address are listed for intake. Eligibility rules are not on the site.

records.notes: The batch website (nprdpinc.org) belongs to the National Puerto Rican Day Parade in New York, not to APM, so it was not used. The newest dated item is a 2026-07-07 press release about board leadership. A search summary says programs run in Spanish and English, but the site does not say so, so no language tag was set.

records.name: BLJ Community Rowing
records.summary: A community rowing club that teaches people to row, including young people and adults. It holds community events at the Gillin Boathouse in West Fairmount Park.
records.what_you_do: Come to a community event such as the walk and row day, or ask the club how to sign up for a learn-to-row clinic.

schedule.text: A 2026 community walk and row event was held on Wednesday 2026-05-13, 5 to 7 pm, at the Gillin Boathouse. Other clinic dates are not listed on pages we could open.

cost.text: Free learn-to-row clinics were reported in 2021 to 2023 coverage. Current prices are not confirmed.

first_step.how: Come to the next community rowing event at the Gillin Boathouse, or ask the club how to sign up for a learn-to-row clinic.
first_step.basis: Events are posted with a date and place. The pages we could open do not explain how to sign up for a clinic.

records.notes: The club's own website was not located. The boathouse.com blog about BLJ returned HTTP 403, so it is listed under blocked. The citywidestories facts (founded 2013, clinics, a claim by the club to be the only Black-owned rowing club in the US) come from a search summary, and the page itself was not opened. The street address 2200 Kelly Drive appears in a search summary only, so it is left out of locations. Current clinic schedule and cost are not confirmed.

records.name: Cambodian American Girls Empowering (CAGE)
records.summary: A Philadelphia group that teaches traditional Cambodian dance to young Cambodian American women. The most recent coverage we found is from 2018, so current activity is not confirmed.
records.what_you_do: Ask the Cambodian Association of Greater Philadelphia whether its dance program is running. In 2018 coverage, the workshops were free to attend.

cost.text: Workshops were free in 2018 coverage. No current price is listed.

first_step.how: Ask the Cambodian Association of Greater Philadelphia at cagp.org whether its dance program is running and how to join.
first_step.basis: No current schedule or sign up step was found. The only description is from 2018 coverage.

records.notes: Dormant because the newest evidence is over 24 months old. The Cultural Fund grantee listing names the group, but its first page did not show it. The 2018 coverage was read through search summaries, not opened. The parent Cambodian Association's About page lists no dance program and does not mention CAGE. One repost spells the acronym CASE. Verify before publishing as current.

records.name: Centennial Parkside CDC
records.summary: A community development group for East Parkside that works to preserve and revitalize the area through partnerships. In May 2026 it listed a spring festival in North Star Park.
records.what_you_do: Go to a neighborhood festival or event, or ask the office how to get involved.

schedule.text: The 2026 East Parkside spring festival in North Star Park was held on a Saturday in May, 11 am to 2 pm. Office hours are not listed.

cost.text: The festival cost is not stated.

first_step.how: Go to the next East Parkside festival in North Star Park, or call the office at 267-225-8356 to ask how to get involved.
first_step.basis: Festivals are posted as public events, and the group publishes an involvement page and contact details. Volunteer steps are not spelled out.

records.notes: The group's own site shows no dated item after 2023 (a hiring notice dated 2023-09-13) and lists no current programs. The 2026 festival comes from the Love Your Park listing. That listing links only an Instagram post, so no social links are recorded here. Whether the festival recurs is not confirmed.

records.name: Crossroads Women's Center
records.summary: A grassroots women's center in Germantown that runs social justice and support programs. These include advocacy on SNAP and Medicaid, food justice work, and a weekly rummage sale.
records.what_you_do: Attend a fundraiser or a virtual mindfulness class, or shop or donate at the weekly rummage sale.

schedule.text: Virtual mindfulness meditation classes start on 2026-09-22. A soup fundraiser runs on Saturday 2026-09-26, 5 to 7 pm. A weekly rummage sale runs too; its day is not stated.

cost.text: Cost is not stated. The group raises money through fundraisers.

first_step.how: Come to the Queer Soup Night fundraiser on Saturday 2026-09-26, 5 to 7 pm, at 7165 Germantown Avenue.
first_step.basis: Events are posted with a date, time and place, but the pages do not explain how to join the programs.

records.notes: No own website was found. The only web source is a Germantown Info Hub article dated 2026-09-21. Kind is set to nonprofit because the article calls it a women's center that holds fundraisers, but nonprofit status is not stated. A later fundraiser is listed for Oct. 17 at the Johnson House, with no year given. The community tag comes from the article's statement that the center serves women.

records.name: Golden Slipper NYB

records.name: The Historical Society of Frankford
records.summary: A Frankford history group that collects and shares local records. It runs a museum open by appointment and a library research service, and it hosts free monthly lectures.
records.what_you_do: Attend a free lecture, book a museum visit or research help, or watch past lectures on the Society's YouTube channel.

schedule.text: Monthly evening lectures, March to June and September to December. Doors open at 7 pm and the talk starts at 7:30 pm. The next lecture is 2026-10-13.

cost.text: Lectures are free and open to the public. Museum visits are by appointment, and their cost is not stated.

first_step.how: Come to the free lecture on 2026-10-13 at 1507 Orthodox Street. Doors open at 7 pm and the talk starts at 7:30 pm. Free parking is across Orthodox Street at Frankford Friends School.
first_step.basis: Lectures are free, open to the public, and posted with a clear time and place.

records.notes: The 2026-10-13 lecture is the newest dated item. The page shows no publication date for it, so last_sign_of_life is the lecture month. The Cultural Fund calendar lists the same October lecture as a second source. No email is published, so none is recorded. Museum and research service costs are not stated.

notes: Batch check: none of the 15 items is a park or playground Friends group, so the stewardship office fallback was not needed. The batch mixes a caving grotto, Cultural Fund arts and culture groups, Mummers, and a rowing club. Verdicts: 14 publish (of which 4 are unknown with minimal records and no sources: Al-Bustan, COSACOSA, East Passyunk, GHASP; CAGE is dormant; AMC 20s and 30s is probably_active with no last_sign_of_life date, which conflicts with the tier 1 rule and is flagged in its notes), 1 out_of_area (Seven Valleys Grotto). Several batch website values were aggregators or wrong: the Cultural Fund calendar and grantee directory, the Love Your Park page for BLJ and Centennial, the Meetup find page for AMC and GHASP, the Mummers lineup for Golden Slipper, and nprdpinc.org (a New York parade group) for APM. Each was replaced with the group's own site where one was reachable. Searches: all 3 used (APM, BLJ, CAGE), so no searches were left for GHASP, COSACOSA, East Passyunk, Al-Bustan or the Golden Slipper club. Fetches: 27 of 60. No contact was made with any group, and nothing was submitted or logged in.
